question: Which ATT&CK techniques does CAPEC-644 (Use of Captured Hashes (Pass The Hash)) map to, and what mitigations apply to those techniques?

answer.headline: Gathered 2 record(s) from 2 source(s); 1 cross-source correlation(s) on shared identifiers.
answer.narrative: CAPEC-644 (Use of Captured Hashes (Pass The Hash)) maps to the ATT&CK technique T1550.002 (Pass the Hash). The mitigations identified for this technique are Update Software (M1051), Privileged Account Management (M1026), User Account Management (M1018), and User Account Control (M1052).
